posts.body: HHS has until October 30 to confirm in writing that none of its own attorneys will represent an unaccompanied child in immigration court, under [a letter led by Senator Tammy Duckworth](https://immigration-analytics.com/2026/10/20/hhs-unaccompanied-children-lawyers/) and signed by five other Democratic senators. posts.title: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for TPUs

posts.body: Google has [open-sourced TorchTPU](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/google-takes-on-nvidia-with-new-ai-developer-tool/story), a native PyTorch backend that makes its TPUs a first-class hardware target alongside GPUs and CPUs, built with Meta's PyTorch team and announced at PyTorch Conference 2026. The bet is on switching costs: Amazon shipped its own no-rewrite port, TorchNeuron, the same week, so the GPU default now has two funded exits.

posts.title: Protein plus lifting beat lifting alone in 23-trial review
posts.excerpt: Pooling 23 randomized trials in 611 young adults, a Frontiers in Nutrition meta-analysis published October 13 found lifters adding protein gained 7.40 kg more on their squat than lifters training…
posts.body: Pooling 23 randomized trials in 611 young adults, [a Frontiers in Nutrition meta-analysis](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/nutrition/articles/10.3389/fnut.2026.1946052/full) published October 13 found lifters adding protein gained 7.40 kg more on their squat than lifters training without it. The edge showed up mainly when lifters took protein both around their workouts and before sleep.

posts.title: Creatine built muscle even without exercise, trial finds
posts.excerpt: Adults taking 10 grams of creatine a day gained about 2.4 pounds of lean tissue over 12 weeks with no structured exercise program, a September Texas A&M trial found. Those who paired the same dose…
posts.body: Adults taking 10 grams of creatine a day gained about 2.4 pounds of lean tissue over 12 weeks with no structured exercise program, [a September Texas A&M trial](https://www.womenfitness.net/news-flash/creatine-build-muscle-without/) found. Those who paired the same dose with training three times a week and a modest calorie deficit added nearly 3 pounds of lean tissue while cutting more body fat than the placebo group, which the researchers call the first trial to show the combo beating diet and exercise alone on body-fat percentage.

posts.body: In the [Finnish trial](https://macrosmeasure.com/blog/is-there-a-ceiling-on-training-volume-what-the-63-sets-a-week-study-says-about-more-is-better), 27 trained athletes who pushed leg training to about 60 weekly sets gained no significant extra muscle or strength over the group holding near 40, with deadlift gains actually favoring the lower-volume group, 6.3% versus 4.3%. A separate October systematic review found volume load (sets × reps × weight) the variable most consistently tied to hypertrophy: progressive overload is the engine, and extra sets past the productive zone mostly add fatigue.
